scope: The closed GC/tail-call instruction and value-type vocabulary represented by PsWasmModule, before Binary.lean encoding.
invariants: unique declared names and resolvable references
no noValue sentinel in value positions
structure parents precede children, are non-final, and admit immutable field-prefix covariance
operand type and arity for every represented instruction
balanced if/else frames with exact block results and no cross-frame stack underflow
unreachable code retains concrete operand checks and only empty-frame pops are polymorphic
non-null GC locals require definite initialization; branch-local initialization is reset at control boundaries
direct and indirect call signatures, tail results, and final function results
declared ref.func targets and GC/function reference hierarchy separation
packed field/array access mode and mutable array destinations
array copy storage compatibility and non-defaultable array element rejection

matchingPolicy.heapReferences: exact nominal identity or declared structure-supertype chain
matchingPolicy.functionReferences: exact named function-type identity after ref.func with explicit typeName or ref.cast; anonymous references remain abstract funcref until cast
matchingPolicy.tailResults: exact result sequence; broader subtype-equivalent sequences are conservatively declined
matchingPolicy.recursiveTypeEquivalence: arbitrary isorecursive equivalence across distinct type identities is not inferred

resources.arrayNewFixed: u32 immediate; known operand stack or unreachable shortcut bounds pops
limitations: list-based context lookups and subtype checks are not constant time
host time/memory limits remain caller/runner obligations

validation.externalOracle: existing emitted-byte engine validation and whole-compiler instantiation

evidence.scope: native target-IR corpus, portable source/profile checks, backend engine validation, whole-Wasm generation and instantiation
